status: ACTUAL exploratory original-photo source fit, NO reliable moth-specific island ALAN effect

source.GloBI_source: bounded 61,967 claim cache, NOT full v0.11 release
source.light: same-year FOUR-MONTH VIIRS sample, not annual nightlight
source.outcome: share of originally photographed WCVP accepted species with ANY positive GloBI moth/butterfly record elsewhere

model: Within original same year x 5-degree geographic block, year-block-balanced island/mainland photo-sites; adjusted logVIIRS x island, photo attempts, accepted taxon count, population, bio5, rainfall, elevation; geography-block clustered t interval.

criteria.broad: at least three original photo attempts and two accepted photographed plant species
criteria.strict: at least five attempts and three photographed plant species

multiple_testing.family: two source coverage thresholds x four source evidence versions x moth/butterfly response

caveats: GloBI interaction elsewhere != local moth visitor nor effective nocturnal pollination
Moth/butterfly evidence overlap is not duplicate independent species; the difference response cancels shared positives
Species unrecorded in GloBI are not proven absent of moth visitation
Photographed species fractions are not biological species richness or abundances
Four-month original VIIRS is not annual ALAN
Source and geographic overlap sensitivity do not establish a robust mechanism
Source-only time classification is a proxy: no actual nocturnal event time, gecko data or confirmed naturalized flora used
